reviews.text: I purchased two O. W. Lee chairs from this location and was promised they would be there that week. I ordered two new chairs and requested they be left in the boxes. reviews.text: I was given a quality set of gas logs for our new house with a fireplace. I decided to have a professional install them to make sure it was done right. Jason was knowledgeable and eager to get me taken care of. The day of the install things didn’t go as smooth. My installation window was 10:30-12:30. At 9:30 I received an automated message that the installer was 15 minutes away. I had to leave an event early and rush home. The installer called 10 minutes later upset I wasn’t home. I arrived shortly after and let him in to begin work. After unwrapping his brand new tools he promptly broke the gas line coming into the fireplace. He offered a solution I wasn’t confident he was qualified to perform. I asked the he finish the set up of the logs and that I would try to find a solution to the broken gas line. He quickly finished and left. I contacted the store to get help with possible solutions. Jason was again helpful and offered a couple different solutions. Then the store manager stepped in and shut everything down. She stated that they had completed their install and I had refused the installer’s fix. I feel that my opinion, observations, and concerns were completely ignored by the manager.  Now it looks as though I’m going to be out a considerable amount of money to fix their installer’s screw up.
